setup: lsof -i -sTCP:LISTEN | grep 8983 || if [[ -z $SOLR_PORT ]] ; then echo 'There is already something running on port 8983, export SOLR_PORT=8999 or similar to choose a different port' && exit 1; fi
devbox services up -b  && sleep 5 || echo 'services are already running'
delete_solr_collections: curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/blacklight-core/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'pulmap core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/dss-core/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'pulmap core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/pulmap-core/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'pulmap core was already deleted'
